title: Categories
description: The kinds of devices in the catalog (gateways, touchscreens, dimmer actuators, …). Each category defines which attributes its products have.
readOnly: You can view this category but not change it.

section.attributesHint: Values stored on each product, or on each of its variants (e.g. width, bus system, colour).
section.instanceAttributesHint: Values filled in per installed unit in a project (e.g. bus address, MAC address).

field.name: Name
field.activeHint: Inactive categories are hidden from the catalog but keep their products.
field.unitHint: Display only, e.g. TE, mA, W
field.label: Label
field.descriptionHint: Shown as help under the input.
field.mountingHint: Where products of this category are placed. A product can override it.

scope.hint: Variant values can differ per variant, e.g. colour.

link.hint: Linking takes the field's type, unit and options, and its meaning.
link.locked: Set by the linked catalog field.
